=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING (advisory, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1) scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2464-2467 (unblock_main, the new #9946 guard)
  PROBLEM: The guard accepts any done wait without checking that the "Planning blocked" comment came after it. A wait marked done by the "did not merge in time; the unblock judge decides again" branch (lines 2315-2318) still has an unmerged fix-up, so a later run can close the issue on a nothing-to-implement block that is older than that fix-up.
  WHY: The issue targets the case where "the block arrives after that wait has already ended". Suggested fix: when wait_state is "done", also require the newest trusted "Planning blocked" comment's created_at to be later than wait_at (or wait_updated), using the same selection as lines 639-643. Estimated 6-8 lines.
- HARDENING (advisory) scripts/unblock_judge.sh:694-701 (unblock_nothing_to_implement_close, the label and close failure returns when called with an empty fixup)
  PROBLEM: On the no-wait path, a failed label or close write returns 0 and leaves no marker that scripts/unblock_scan.py throttles on (MARKER_PREFIXES at unblock_scan.py:101 only covers ai:unblock:v1 and ai:unblock-wait:v1).
  WHY: A write that keeps failing is redispatched every --inflight-minutes and never uses a round or escalates. Suggested fix: keep the behaviour, but log a distinct reason token for the no-wait path. Estimated 2-3 lines.
- HARDENING (advisory) scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2464-2467 (unblock_main, the new #9946 guard)
  PROBLEM: An issue reopened with /reclarify that still carries ai:blocked and has no new plan is closed again by this path, because unblock_nothing_to_implement_blocked only treats a later "implementation plan" as planning having moved on.
  WHY: Before this PR, such an issue fell through to the model judge. The reviewer could not confirm whether ai:blocked survives the close. Suggested fix: skip the call when a trusted (OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR) "/reclarify" comment is newer than the newest "Planning blocked" comment. Estimated 4-6 lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- HARDENING (advisory, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1) scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2464 (the guard condition `{ [ -z "${wait}" ] || [ "${wait_state:-}" = "done" ]; }` in unblock_main)
  PROBLEM: The guard accepts a `done` wait whether it was marked done before or after the "Planning blocked" comment. If the "did not merge in time" branch marked it done, the fix-up may be unmerged, and a later run could close the issue on an older nothing-to-implement block.
  WHY: The issue could be closed too early while it still needs the unmerged fix-up. Suggested fix: when `wait_state` is `done`, require the newest trusted nothing-to-implement block's `created_at` to be later than `wait_updated`, read from item_comments.json.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING (advisory, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2) scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2464-2467 (the #9946 guard)
  PROBLEM: When `wait_state` is `done` because the wait expired at lines 2315-2318 ("did not merge in time"), the fix-up is still open. The guard can then close the issue as completed on a block older than the wait, contradicting the judge's outstanding fix-up decision.
  WHY: A timestamp comparison would exclude this case. Suggested fix: when `wait_state` is `done`, require the newest trusted nothing-to-implement block's `created_at` to be later than `wait_at`/`wait_updated`, either by passing the threshold into `unblock_nothing_to_implement_blocked` or by re-reading it from `item_comments.json`. Estimated 6-8 lines.
- HARDENING (advisory, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2) scripts/unblock_judge.sh:694-706 (skip/failed-write log paths in `unblock_nothing_to_implement_close`, reached from the no-wait call site)
  PROBLEM: On a persistent comment, label or close write failure on the no-wait path, nothing throttles re-dispatch. The `ai:unblock-nothing-to-implement:v1` prefix is not in `MARKER_PREFIXES_FOR_STREAK` in scripts/unblock_ledger.py:297, and a comment_failed leaves no comment at all.
  WHY: The scan re-dispatches the unblock judge on every tick until a write succeeds, because this path has no `ai:unblock-wait:v1` anchor. Suggested fix: append `<!-- ai:unblock-wait:v1 item=${ITEM} reason=nothing_to_implement -->` to the close comment (compare lines 717-718), or extend the streak prefix list. Estimated 2-3 lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
